Source-assisted reading of F-stvt (Stams, Stiftsarchiv, Frg. 256). The following lines were reread on the image with the 1568 print of Johannes de Blanasco's commentary in view: strip 1 face "1v" lines 1-10 and face "1r" lines 6-9. Strip 3 face "3v" lines 3-7 and strip 2 face "2v" column b lines 1-9 were first read by a second reader without the source, and lines marked [after source] were then corrected with the print in view. Parentheses expand abbreviations, [...] marks text lost at a cut edge, (?) marks an uncertain reading, and | marks a red-ink item. Nothing else on the record is read here.
